fields.Name: W1 -> S6.3
fields.Description: Gate G2.39 (phase 2, dataset W1, criterion S6.3): on W1-signal s42-s44 each of logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, LightGBM and MLP is reported with log loss, Brier and a calibration slope; a family whose slope lies in 0.8-1.2 is offered and one outside is hidden by the hide rule, matching the gate's declared hidden cells (LightGBM s43, random forest s42, MLP s42), 15 of 15 cells. A sidecar-level measurement: the hide rule over the trainer's reported slopes; the UI path that hides a family arrives in a later milestone. It fails when the hide rule never hides a family (a family with a slope outside 0.8-1.2 is offered).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Every W1 family is calibrated (slope 0.8-1.2) or hidden by the hide rule, 15 of 15 family x seed cells (15 of 15 pytest cases pass).
